mapper.select: SELECT coupon_id AS couponId, name AS name, discount_type AS discountType, discount_value AS discountValue, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, quantity AS quantity FROM coupons WHERE end_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND quantity > 0 ORDER BY coupon_id ASC

SELECT uc.user_coupon_id AS userCouponId, uc.user_id AS userId, uc.coupon_id AS couponId, uc.used AS used, uc.issued_at AS issuedAt, uc.expires_at AS expiresAt, uc.used_at AS usedAt, c.name AS name, c.discount_type AS discountType, c.discount_value AS discountValue FROM user_coupons uc INNER JOIN coupons c ON uc.coupon_id = c.coupon_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uc.user_coupon_id DESC

SELECT coupon_id AS couponId, name AS name, discount_type AS discountType, discount_value AS discountValue, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, quantity AS quantity FROM coupons WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_coupons WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND coupon_id = #{couponId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupons (user_id, coupon_id, used, issued_at, expires_at, used_at) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{couponId}, #{used}, CAST(#{issuedAt} AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(#{expiresAt} AS DATE), CAST(#{usedAt} AS TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE coupons SET quantity = quantity - 1 WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId} AND quantity > 0
UPDATE user_coupons SET used = true, used_at = CAST(#{usedAt} AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE user_coupon_id = #{userCouponId}
